meta.title: Contact
meta.description: Contact Collège Tomi Fidele: address, phone numbers, WhatsApp, email, school office opening hours, location map and contact form.

hero.title: Contact the {school}
hero.intro: The school office answers your questions by phone, on WhatsApp or in person.

form.title: Any questions? {Write to us}
form.intro: Your message goes straight to the school office, which will get back to you.
form.required: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
form.errorSummary: The form is not complete: please correct the fields marked in red.
form.privacy: Your message is only shared with the school office and is erased after 12 months.
form.template:
Hello, I am writing to you from the %school% website.

Subject: %subject%
Name: %name%
Phone: %phone%

%message%

done.title: Your message is ready
done.sent: WhatsApp opens with your message. All that is left is to tap Send.
done.noNumber: The school office's WhatsApp number is not online yet. Copy this message and pass it on to the school.

whatsappOnly.intro: Your message opens in WhatsApp, ready to send to the school office.
whatsappOnly.privacy: Your message only goes to WhatsApp: this site does not store it.

consent.label: I agree that the school may store this information to reply to me.
consent.error: Tick this box to send the message.

saved.title: Message sent
saved.callback: The school office will reply on %phone%.
saved.whatsapp: Also let them know on WhatsApp

failed.network: Sending failed: the connection was interrupted. Please try again in a moment.
failed.throttled: Several messages were just sent from this device. Please wait a quarter of an hour, or call the school office.
failed.invalid: Some information was not accepted. Check the form, then try again.
failed.server: The sending service is not responding right now.
failed.fallbackCopy: Prepare a message to pass on
